verdict.rationale: Numeral documents that it files and remits returns, and its official MCP server exposes the account's filings as callable tools. That gives some first-party visibility into filings. However, nothing in the evidence describes a filing calendar, per-filing status fields, remitted amounts, or downloadable return confirmations; the 'filings waiting on my review' example is phrased as a question and is not counted as support. missing for 10: calendar of upcoming returns, documented per-filing status, remitted-amount reporting, downloadable filing confirmations, dashboard/UI evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see the whole filing picture — a calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status, the amounts remitted, and downloadable confirmations for every return submitted

citations.quote: The Numeral MCP server is a single HTTPS endpoint that exposes your Numeral account — nexus, filings, registrations, transactions, sales, products, and exemption certificates — as tools an AI agent can call directly.
Register, file, and remit across US and global jurisdictions, on time, every time.
